assumptions: Assumes weather turns colder by mid-November

description: Typhoon or political closure of the main southern Vietnam port (Ho Chi Minh City) stops Vietnam-origin stock for several weeks
mitigation_plan: Pre-book an alternate port, air freight standby and 3 weeks buffer on top Vietnam lines
assumptions: Assumes closure under 6 weeks and alternate port capacity at current rates

description: K-1700 kettle and PF-220 fan are both made at one conditionally approved factory (FAC-0027, audit rating C); an outage stops about 1.3m of annual sales
mitigation_plan: Qualify FAC-0026 as a second site; re-audit FAC-0027
assumptions: Assumes FAC-0027 passes its re-audit by Q1

description: Asia-UK ocean freight rates rise 30% during peak as carrier capacity tightens
mitigation_plan: Fix peak rates with ocean carriers; move some volume to rail

description: Cotton and yarn prices up 12% feed into AW27 cost prices before negotiations conclude
mitigation_plan: Forward price fixing with the top three cotton suppliers
assumptions: Assumes suppliers accept fixed prices through Q1

description: Sterling weakens 8% against the dollar; most buying is in USD and only 55% is hedged
mitigation_plan: Extend GBP/USD forward cover from 55% to 80%

description: Energy and fuel cost increases at DCs and stores through winter
mitigation_plan: Move to a 12-month fixed-price energy contract
assumptions: Assumes current tariff is extended to March

description: Peak season labour shortage in DC and store teams cuts throughput
mitigation_plan: Agency labour framework and early peak recruitment
assumptions: Assumes agency supply is available at 15% premium

description: SUP-0048 (Vietnam electronics supplier, rated critical) at risk of financial distress after missed payments to its own suppliers
mitigation_plan: Move to early payment terms and dual-source its top lines
assumptions: Assumes SUP-0048 keeps trading through peak

description: Trade tension: new tariffs or export controls on China-origin goods (China supplies about a quarter of revenue)
mitigation_plan: Diversify the largest China-origin categories to India, Vietnam and Turkey; track UK and US measures

description: Red Sea and Suez shipping attacks force Asia-UK sailings round the Cape, adding 10-14 days of transit
mitigation_plan: Plan 2 weeks extra lead time on Asia orders; keep air freight standby
assumptions: Assumes carriers keep sailing via the Cape

description: Political instability and strikes in Bangladesh disrupt garment production and exports
mitigation_plan: Split Bangladesh volume across suppliers and a second port; monitor unrest alerts
assumptions: Assumes the current government remains in place

description: Monsoon flooding and cyclones at Chittagong port and Bangladesh factories disrupt kids and babywear supply each year
mitigation_plan: Pre-position buffer stock before cyclone season; flood-proof factory audits
assumptions: Assumes monsoon intensity follows the last ten years

description: Stronger typhoons and heat in southern Vietnam damage ports and factories more often
mitigation_plan: Climate-risk screening of Vietnam factories; alternate port plan
assumptions: Assumes two major typhoon seasons in three years

description: Drought and heat cut cotton yields in India and Turkey, raising input prices and delaying orders
mitigation_plan: Forward buy cotton; develop recycled-cotton ranges
assumptions: Assumes yields recover within two seasons

description: UK and EU forced-labour import bans and supply chain due-diligence rules require raw-material traceability for cotton products
mitigation_plan: Map tier-2 and tier-3 suppliers; require traceability data in contracts

description: EU and UK battery regulation: 86 lithium-ion battery SKUs need new carbon footprint and passport data
mitigation_plan: Collect battery data from electricals suppliers; delist non-compliant SKUs
assumptions: Assumes suppliers can provide data by Q2

description: UK carbon border adjustment mechanism adds carbon costs to imported steel, aluminium and ceramics from 2027
mitigation_plan: Request embedded-carbon data; price in the levy
assumptions: Assumes UK CBAM starts in January 2027

description: Packaging EPR fees escalate as modulated fees start
mitigation_plan: Redesign packaging to cut fee bands

description: Cyber attack on the e-commerce platform or WMS halts online orders; DC2 fulfils about 71% of online order value
mitigation_plan: Penetration testing, offline order capture and WMS failover plan

description: Chittagong port strike or congestion delays Bangladesh-origin kids lines beyond planned lead times
mitigation_plan: Agree strike playbook; hold 6 weeks safety stock on top lines
assumptions: Assumes port keeps 70% of throughput during a strike and delays stay under 5 days

description: Air freight cannot absorb diverted Bangladesh volumes at planned cost
mitigation_plan: Pre-agree air freight rates with SkyBridge Air Cargo
assumptions: Assumes 80% of diverted volume can fly at standard rates

description: Safety stock on Bangladesh kids lines set at 4 weeks cover is too thin for port disruption
mitigation_plan: Review safety stock policy for single-port origins
assumptions: Assumes 4 weeks cover is enough for a 5-day delay

description: Tariffs on China-origin electronics components; supplier switches already agreed
mitigation_plan: Alternative sourcing in place for top electricals lines

description: WMS integration delays at DC1 mitigated with phased rollout
mitigation_plan: Phased rollout plan with fallback procedures in place
